attributes.why_unmapped: SUCCESSOR_ASSUMPTION: If the Surviving Corporation or Parent (or their successors/assigns) merges out of existence, transfers substantially all assets, or is dissolved, Parent must ensure the successor, assign, or transferee expressly assumes the Section 6.05 obligations.

attributes.why_unmapped: PENDING_CLAIM_SURVIVAL: For any Proceeding asserted or made during the six-year survival window, indemnification rights continue past that window until the Proceeding is finally disposed of.
